parts:
Hi all,

Bonnie gave a great talk yesterday about using dates and times in R, and has provided the script that she walked through during her presentation.  It's up on as a blog post now here:

http://www.noamross.net/blog/2014/2/10/using-times-and-dates-in-r---presentation-code.html

I note people are already beginning to ask questions in the comments.  Bonnie, perhaps you can keep an eye on questions there and field them?

Noam
